target.title: feat: add sticker sends
target.body:
## Summary

- add one public surface: `imsg send-sticker` and JSON-RPC `send.sticker`
- support standalone stickers and exact message-part attachment through the injected IMCore bridge
- validate and privately stage PNG/APNG, GIF, and JPEG assets before Messages sees them
- expose fail-closed `stickerSend` / `stickerAttach` selector capabilities

## Maintainer rewrite

This branch keeps Omar's native reverse-engineering and runtime findings, but rewrites the public contract and trust boundaries:

- removed the unshipped `sticker`, `attachments.sendSticker`, and `sticker.send` aliases
- strict RPC object/type/key/chat-selector validation
- iMessage/iMessageLite only; shared identifiers prefer an iMessage chat
- exact target normalization and live-chat membership checks before transfer allocation
- single-read, component-safe `openat` validation; 500 KiB, 618x618, 100-frame, and 25-million-decoded-pixel caps
- full-frame decode plus truncated PNG/GIF/JPEG rejection
- neutral `Sticker` accessibility metadata; local source basenames are not transmitted
- SHA-256 byte-integrity checks; native-compatible MD5 sticker hash and canonical staged filename ID
- two-phase transfer preparation/registration and fail-closed attachment/association initializers
- release/notarization builds isolate SwiftPM products per architecture, preventing stale slices from entering universal artifacts
- status, RPC docs, skill guidance, and regression coverage

## Redacted exact-head proof


Recipient-visible screenshot artifact:

![PR164 redacted recipient sticker proof](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/omarshahine/2acdad85491b42c0e27ceda2dcb0e101/raw/pr164-sticker-recipient-proof.svg)

The screenshot shows the recipient-side Messages transcript with the PR164 proof text and a rendered sticker attached over the target message bubble. It contains no phone numbers or handles beyond the test chat display name.

Proof was collected on refreshed branch head `0f1924c` in the real `Lobster Test Group` iMessage group, with private handles and local paths redacted in the summary below.

Runtime capability after relaunching the branch helper:

```json
{
  "bridge_version": 2,
  "v2_ready": true,
  "selectors": {
    "stickerSend": true,
    "stickerAttach": true,
    "stickerAssociatedMessage": true,
    "stickerAttachmentMessage": true,
    "stickerReplyTo": false
  },
  "rpc_methods": ["send.sticker"]
}
```

Standalone sticker send returned:

```json
{
  "messageGuid": "B73CDFAE-0423-49B8-A594-0391EDCC9521",
  "transferGuid": "DAB8D310-8BB6-42D5-B327-6ECC47FADEA3",
  "selectedMessageGuid": "",
  "targetPartIndex": 0
}
```

Exact-part attached sticker send to that standalone sticker message returned:

```json
{
  "messageGuid": "48C121B6-C87D-4B1D-8487-C4DBE97950E5",
  "transferGuid": "5A736866-8E7E-4D14-8DDE-9B059B6883C4",
  "selectedMessageGuid": "B73CDFAE-0423-49B8-A594-0391EDCC9521",
  "targetPartIndex": 0
}
```

Redacted DB proof for the attached row:

```json
{
  "ROWID": 6893,
  "guid": "48C121B6-C87D-4B1D-8487-C4DBE97950E5",
  "is_from_me": 1,
  "associated_message_guid": "p:0/B73CDFAE-0423-49B8-A594-0391EDCC9521",
  "associated_message_type": 1000,
  "cache_has_attachments": 1,
  "chat_guid": "any;+;<redacted-group-id>"
}
```

Redacted attachment join proof:

```json
{
  "message_guid": "48C121B6-C87D-4B1D-8487-C4DBE97950E5",
  "attachment_guid": "5A736866-8E7E-4D14-8DDE-9B059B6883C4",
  "filename": "~/Library/Messages/Attachments/imsg/stickers/<redacted>/13285d97dc50e851dff55277f6a87527baae1bcb194f0e98431d89494696b48a.png",
  "mime_type": "image/png",
  "uti": "public.png",
  "total_bytes": 6902,
  "is_sticker": 1,
  "hide_attachment": 0
}
```

`imsg history --attachments` decoded both rows as sticker attachments and resolved the attached row back to the exact parent:

```json
{
  "id": 6893,
  "guid": "48C121B6-C87D-4B1D-8487-C4DBE97950E5",
  "reply_to_guid": "B73CDFAE-0423-49B8-A594-0391EDCC9521",
  "attachments": [{ "is_sticker": true, "mime_type": "image/png", "uti": "public.png", "total_bytes": 6902 }]
}
```

This proof also found and fixed two exact-head issues before the final run:

- sticker staging had the same macOS home-path `O_NOFOLLOW` problem as rich links; it now anchors below the trusted imsg sticker root and walks only descendants with `openat(... O_NOFOLLOW)`
- exact attachment no longer depends on the unavailable `setReplyToGUID:` selector; the associated-message initializer path is sufficient and is what produced the attached sticker row above

## Verification

- `make build` - passed; universal release artifacts built (`imsg`: arm64 + x86_64; helper: arm64e + arm64 + x86_64)
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make lint` - passed; 9 existing SwiftLint warnings, 0 serious
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make test` - passed; 432 tests
- `git diff --check` - passed

Apple's public sticker constraints are documented in [MSSticker](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/messages/mssticker/init%28contentsoffileurl%3Alocalizeddescription%3A%29).

## Summary
- add bridge action for native poll unvote updates
- expose `imsg poll unvote`
- expose JSON-RPC `poll.unvote`, `polls.unvote`, and `messages.poll.unvote`
- unvote now reads the sender's latest native full-selection snapshot, removes only the requested option, and sends the remaining selected option identifiers
- fix native empty-vote readback so unvote rows decode as poll vote/update evidence
- add status selector reporting, docs, and command/RPC coverage
- remove the unproven add-option surface from this PR; it needs a separate follow-up after visual append behavior is proven

## Redacted exact-head proof
Proof collected on lobster against exact head `1d38dc1` in the real `Lobster Test Group` iMessage group with the branch-built universal CLI/helper. Raw logs are local under `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-10/162-selective-unvote-*` because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, handles, and participant identifiers.

Setup note: Messages.app has no public imsg command to create a multi-select poll snapshot. To create the required precondition, I used the branch helper's raw v2 `send-poll-unvote` bridge action once with `remainingOptionIdentifiers=[Alpha,Beta]`. The behavior under review was then exercised through the public `imsg poll unvote` command.

Fresh poll created on exact head:

```json
{
  "messageGuid": "CF492830-8495-4620-9F0A-A3DDCF3F5880",
  "poll": {
    "question": "PR162 A+B unvote proof 20260710-115344",
    "options": [
      { "id": "1D130315-134B-4C52-8487-FB48A5F08E85", "text": "Alpha" },
      { "id": "7E83A9E9-A665-4793-A734-F5F4BD2A9897", "text": "Beta" }
    ]
  }
}
```

Before state, read back from `imsg history --chat-id 22 --json`, showed both selections in the native full snapshot:

```json
{
  "guid": "41FA9252-E3E9-4563-8B7F-DDDEB984DCC7",
  "poll_guid": "CF492830-8495-4620-9F0A-A3DDCF3F5880",
  "poll": {
    "votes": [
      { "option_id": "1D130315-134B-4C52-8487-FB48A5F08E85", "option_text": "Alpha", "event_type": "selected" },
      { "option_id": "7E83A9E9-A665-4793-A734-F5F4BD2A9897", "option_text": "Beta", "event_type": "selected" }
    ]
  }
}
```

Public command under test:

```sh
./bin/imsg poll unvote \
  --chat 'any;+;<redacted-group-id>' \
  --poll CF492830-8495-4620-9F0A-A3DDCF3F5880 \
  --option-id 1D130315-134B-4C52-8487-FB48A5F08E85 \
  --json
```

Command output showed only Beta carried forward:

```json
{
  "removed": true,
  "optionIdentifier": "1D130315-134B-4C52-8487-FB48A5F08E85",
  "messageGuid": "D55975CD-5FF6-4976-92C6-6D812CE5ABFA",
  "remainingOptionIdentifiers": ["7E83A9E9-A665-4793-A734-F5F4BD2A9897"]
}
```

After state, read back from `imsg history --chat-id 22 --json`, showed Beta remained and Alpha was absent:

```json
{
  "guid": "D55975CD-5FF6-4976-92C6-6D812CE5ABFA",
  "poll_guid": "CF492830-8495-4620-9F0A-A3DDCF3F5880",
  "poll": {
    "votes": [
      { "option_id": "7E83A9E9-A665-4793-A734-F5F4BD2A9897", "option_text": "Beta", "event_type": "selected" }
    ]
  }
}
```

SQLite proof for the public unvote row:

```json
{
  "ROWID": 6897,
  "guid": "D55975CD-5FF6-4976-92C6-6D812CE5ABFA",
  "associated_message_guid": "CF492830-8495-4620-9F0A-A3DDCF3F5880",
  "associated_message_type": 4000,
  "balloon_bundle_id": "com.apple.messages.MSMessageExtensionBalloonPlugin:0000000000:com.apple.messages.Polls",
  "payload_bytes": 670,
  "summary_bytes": 201,
  "chat_guid": "any;+;<redacted-group-id>"
}
```

## Verification
- `make build` passed on `1d38dc1`
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make lint` passed; existing warnings only, 0 serious
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make test` passed: 409 tests
- `git diff --check` passed

target.title: feat: add bridge rich links
target.body:
## Summary

- add canonical URL-only Apple preview sends with `imsg send-rich --url <url>` and RPC `send.rich` using one chat target plus `url`
- fetch LinkPresentation metadata in the CLI process; the injected Messages helper performs no network access
- use a dedicated `send-rich-link` bridge action and action-specific capability so stale helpers fail before fetching or sending
- keep non-URL `send-rich` behavior unchanged for text, effects, replies, subjects, formatting, and attachments

## Maintainer rewrite

This branch was rewritten on current `main`, preserving Omar's feature direction while tightening the public and private-runtime contracts:

- strict HTTP(S), host, credential, title, target, service, and modifier validation
- one eight-second preparation deadline with cancellation propagation and staged-image cleanup
- metadata-only fallback when metadata/image preparation fails; no plain-message downgrade
- accepted images limited to JPEG/PNG/WebP, one frame, 2 MiB, 4096x4096, and 16 megapixels before decode/staging
- SHA-256-bound image descriptors and component-wise `openat`/`O_NOFOLLOW` reads from the real user's Messages attachment tree
- fd identity checks, MIME/dimension verification, and a private 0700/0600 `O_EXCL` snapshot before IMCore sees the file
- balloon construction before daemon transfer registration, avoiding orphaned transfers on archive/KVC failure
- exact `chat_identifier`/`chat_guid` lookup with iMessage preference when SMS and iMessage rows share an identifier
- helper input type validation so malformed bridge JSON cannot crash Messages
- per-architecture Swift scratch paths and `--show-bin-path` packaging to prevent stale universal slices
- docs, skill example, release changelog, and contributor credit

## Redacted exact-head proof

Proof collected on lobster against exact head `8eaa37e` in Lobster Test Group with the branch-built universal CLI/helper. Raw logs are local under `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-10/165-rich-links-*` because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, paths, and local account details.

- Rebuilt exact head with `make build`, then relaunched Messages with `./bin/imsg launch` using `bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib` from this branch.
- `./bin/imsg status --json` reported the branch helper loaded with `selectors.urlPreviewMessage == true` and `selectors.sendRichLinkAction == true`.
- Metadata-only rich URL proof: `imsg send-rich --url https://lobster.shahine.com/ --json` returned success with a message GUID and `richLinkImageUsed: false`; `history`/SQLite show an outbound `com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider` row, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`, no plain text fallback row, and no attachment.
- Second metadata-only proof: `imsg send-rich --url https://imsg.sh --json` returned success with a message GUID and `richLinkImageUsed: false`; SQLite shows an outbound URLBalloonProvider row, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`.
- Image-backed rich card proof: initial exact-head attempt against `https://www.apple.com/` exposed a real helper bug (`Could not securely open rich-link image directory`). Fixed in `8eaa37e` by anchoring the secure directory walk at the trusted Messages attachment root while preserving `openat(... O_NOFOLLOW)` for descendant components.
- After the fix and branch-helper relaunch, `imsg send-rich --url https://www.apple.com/ --json` returned success with a message GUID and `richLinkImageUsed: true`.
- SQLite readback for the image-backed row: outbound `com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider`, `is_sent=1`, `error=0`, `cache_has_attachments=1`, `payload_data` present, and one joined hidden image attachment with `hide_attachment=1`, `mime_type=image/png`, `total_bytes=19060`, and a hashed `.pluginPayloadAttachment` transfer name under `~/Library/Messages/Attachments/imsg/rich-links/...`.
- Adjacent native poll regression proof: immediately after the rich-link sends, `imsg poll send` on the same injected helper returned a Polls message GUID and options; `history` decoded it as `kind=created`, `event=imessage.poll.created`, with the expected options and Polls balloon bundle identifier.

## Verification

- `make build` passed on `8eaa37e`.
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make lint` passed; existing warnings only, 0 serious.
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer make test` passed: 426 tests.
- Live bridge proof above passed for metadata-only URL cards, image-backed URL cards, hidden-transfer persistence, and adjacent Polls balloon construction.

Thanks @omarshahine for the feature and the original runtime investigation.
